## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem or missing capability you are addressing (e.g. *I'm always struggling to practice recursive algorithms...*).

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what feature or user experience you would like to see implemented.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or reference links here.
